text: Busy Saturday: you had 202 orders against a forecast of 197, and sales came to $4,528.00. Jasmine rice ran out at 7:15pm. Chicken thighs jumped from $3.50 to $4.27 (up 22%), which cut about $62.56 from today's profit and hit Pad Thai, Green Curry, Basil Chicken and Thai Fried Rice, with Basil Chicken hit hardest at $0.31 per dish. All three payouts matched what you expected, and no invoices were flagged. Food cost was 29.1% and labor was 19%.
recommendations: Order extra Jasmine rice before your next Saturday, since it's your busiest day and averages 185 orders.
Call your chicken supplier about the $4.27 price on thighs, or check other suppliers for a better one.
Think about a small price increase on Basil Chicken, Green Curry and Pad Thai if the chicken price stays high.
